turns.approach: Test the stated fiber condition with a finite definable partition of a noncontractible semialgebraic sphere.
turns.construction: Two classes on S^2: a north-pole singleton and its complement.
turns.result: Both classes are definably contractible; the logic quotient is finite discrete; the second definable homotopy group upstairs is nonzero and the ordinary group downstairs is zero.
turns.scope: Complete counterexample to the literal formulation without open approximants or continuous projection. Not a counterexample to either repaired version.
turns.follow_on_mathematics: Proved saturation stabilization of definable decreasing intersections, a finite-quotient continuity criterion, and first countability from countable definable fiber presentations. These checks develop the same attempt rather than being counted as four more independent approaches.

early_stop_reason: The literal assertion is disproved. Replacing it by a stronger target would change the hypotheses. The stronger target is preserved as unresolved here, rather than silently consuming a new five-turn budget.
